lines.rpg.elder.wells: Since the {c=#ff8a8a}Dread Knight{/c} took the cave in the northern mountains,{w=.4} our wells have run dry.
lines.rpg.elder.ask: Will you clear the cave for us?
lines.rpg.elder.key: Take its key, and {c=#ffe08a}100 gold{/c} for the road.{w=.3} The inn and the shop are on the square.
lines.rpg.elder.later: I understand.{w=.3} Come back when you are ready.
lines.rpg.elder.again: The cave lies north, past the woods.{w=.3} Follow the road, {$hero}.
lines.rpg.elder.thanks: The water flows again!{w=.4} Brightwater will sing of you, {$hero}.
lines.rpg.quest.cave.text: Clear the cave in the northern mountains, up the road from Brightwater. The elder gave you its key.
lines.rpg.inn.welcome: Welcome to the {c=#ffe08a}Sleeping Dragon{/c}! A night is 10 gold.
lines.rpg.inn.morning: Good morning! You look ready for anything.
lines.rpg.shop.hello: Potions, blades and good armor!{w=.2} Have a look.
lines.rpg.guard.warn: The road north is dangerous.{w=.3} Speak to the elder before you go.
lines.rpg.guard.luck: Good luck, {$hero}. Monsters prowl the woods: walk the road.
lines.rpg.child.song: La la la!{w=.3} Do you like my song?
lines.rpg.child.yay: Yay! I'll sing it when the water comes back!
lines.rpg.child.hmph: Hmph. You sound like my brother.
lines.rpg.woman.full: My well is full again!{w=.3} Thank you!
lines.rpg.woman.hero: They say the knight was a hero once.{w=.4} {s=14}Before the cave changed him...{/s}
lines.rpg.sign: {c=#ffe08a}BRIGHTWATER{/c}{w=.2}  North gate: closed.  South gate: the road.
lines.rpg.sealed: A door of stone, sealed tight.{w=.3} The elder must have its key.
lines.rpg.crystal.heal: A crystal hums with soft light.{w=.3} {c=#8affc0}Your wounds close.{/c}
lines.rpg.knight.rowan: Brightwater wants its water back, knight!
lines.rpg.knight.stones: Then you will {c=#ff6a6a}{wave}join the stones{/wave}{/c}.{w=.5} Come!
lines.rpg.victory.over: It's over.{w=.3} Listen: water, running under the rock.
lines.rpg.victory.home: The spring is free. Let's go home.
lines.rpg.victory.elder: You did it!{w=.4} The wells are full, and Brightwater owes you everything.

brief: The RPG slice: a short JRPG in the manner of Dragon Quest and Final Fantasy. The town of Brightwater's wells ran dry when the Dread Knight took the cave in the northern mountains; three heroes, Rowan (he, the leader and swordsman), Lyra (she, a black mage) and Sera (she, a healer), clear the cave. Townsfolk speak to the party warmly and plainly, the Dread Knight menaces; the tone is light and friendly. Battle commands, menus and items follow Final Fantasy's English conventions (Potion, Hi-Potion, Phoenix Down, Ether); keep them short: they sit in narrow windows and buttons.
